import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds by count
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top_breeds)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(top_breeds.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, top_breeds.values)):
    ax1.text(count + max(top_breeds.values)*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{count:,}', va='center', fontsize=8)

# 2. Dog distribution by district
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors = plt.cm.tab20c(np.linspace(0, 1, len(district_counts)))
bars = ax2.bar(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax2.set_xticklabels([f'Kreis {i+1}' for i in range(len(district_counts))], rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', which='major', pad=2)

# 3. Dog age distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
age_order = df['AlterVHundLang'].dropna().unique()
age_order = sorted(age_order, key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else 0)
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
bars = ax3.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values)
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Dog Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, age_counts.values)):
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + max(age_counts.values)*0.01,
             f'{count:,}', ha='center', fontsize=8, rotation=0)

# 4. Dog gender distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Owner age groups distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
owner_age_order = df['AlterV10Lang'].dropna().unique()
owner_age_order = sorted(owner_age_order, key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else 0)
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().reindex(owner_age_order)
bars = ax5.bar(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values)
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(owner_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Owners', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Dog Owner Age Groups', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, owner_age_counts.values)):
    ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + max(owner_age_counts.values)*0.01,
             f'{count:,}', ha='center', fontsize=8, rotation=0)

# 6. Dog registration trend over years
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
year_counts = df['StichtagDatJahr'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax6.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8)
ax6.fill_between(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, alpha=0.3)
ax6.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Dog Registration Trend (2015-2025)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
for year, count in zip(year_counts.index, year_counts.values):

# 7. Dog color distribution (top 10)

color_counts = df['HundefarbeText'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax7.barh(range(len(color_counts)), color_counts.values)
ax7.set_yticks(range(len(color_counts)))
ax7.set_yticklabels(color_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax7.invert_yaxis()
ax7.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Top 10 Dog Colors', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, color_counts.values)):
    ax7.text(count + max(color_counts.values)*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{count:,}', va='center', fontsize=8)

# 8. Owner gender distribution
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
owner_gender_counts = df['SexLang'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF9A76', '#6A67CE']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax8.pie(owner_gender_counts.values, labels=owner_gender_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax8.set_title('Dog Owner Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Mixed vs Pure Breed Distribution
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
breed_type_counts = df['Rassetyp1Lang'].value_counts()
colors = ['#95CD41', '#FFD93D', '#6BC5D2']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax9.pie(breed_type_counts.values, labels=breed_type_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax9.set_title('Breed Type Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and add main title
plt.suptitle('Zurich Dog Registration Analysis\nComprehensive Overview of Canine Population', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
